paper_title: Realizations of Indecomposable Persistence Modules of Arbitrarily Large Dimension
statement: In addition to our families of indecomposables, other parametrized families might be of interest. More generally, for representation tame commutative grids, could we realize parametrized families that generate all indecomposables?
context: We have illustrated constructions of infinite families of indecomposable persistence modules together with topological realizations over the small commutative grids. By embedding, this provides constructions for all possible representation infinite commutative grids. In addition to our families of indecomposables, other parametrized families might be of interest. More generally, for representation tame commutative grids, could we realize parametrized families that generate all indecomposables?
